Prize odds: 🎰 Jackpot 1% · 💰 Big 4% · 🎁 Medium 10% · 🍬 Small 25%

📖 How to use

  1. Press New Card to get a fresh ticket.
  2. Rub the silver foil with your finger or mouse.
  3. Reveal 40% to auto-clear the card.
  4. Match the prize table — good luck!

❓ Frequently asked questions

What are the odds of winning?

60% no prize, 25% small, 10% medium, 4% big, and a 1% jackpot — every card is random.

How do I scratch on mobile?

Rub with your finger, mouse, or stylus. Scratch 40% of the foil to auto-reveal the card.

Is every card a winner?

No — each new card is freshly random, like a real lottery ticket.

Can I get a new card?

Press New Card anytime for a fresh ticket.
